entries.name: 90s nocturnal cel anime
entries.reason: Krea maintains night-city backgrounds and correct equipment across three seeds; Base background/equipment vary and Turbo duplicates a subject.

entries.name: 90s gothic fantasy cel
entries.reason: Best indigo/magenta atmosphere and fixture preservation; gothic setting specificity remains a limitation.

entries.name: retro sci-fi anime
entries.reason: Base has richer retro/cosmic anime art but wrong side in two samples; Krea preserves fixture in all three but uses simpler gradient scenery. Tradeoff requires reviewer choice.

entries.name: modern flat manga
entries.reason: Krea retains readable single figure and correct equipment in three samples; Anima backgrounds white, Base faces blank and Turbo third duplicated.

entries.name: kawaii pop anime
entries.reason: Most consistent pop rendering and equipment preservation; Base equipment disconnected/ambiguous and Turbo introduces duplicate figure/extra gear.

entries.name: rubber-hose cartoon
entries.reason: Krea is clearly closer to cartoon style, but view drift/rear rendering invalidates strict common FRONT fixture; Anima does not reproduce rubber-hose style well.

entries.name: flat western action cartoon
entries.reason: Krea improves equipment side and geometric style, but third crops equipment and has streak artifacts; Base loses compass and Turbo duplicates a subject. No consistently qualified cell.

entries.name: graphic novel ink
entries.reason: Turbo provides readable cleaner ink subjects but wrong compass side; Krea provides strong ink scene/correct foreground equipment but adds crowds. Base facial legibility weak.

entries.name: manga screentone noir
entries.reason: Base has the strongest consistent screentone treatment but wrong side; Turbo adds extra views in third; Krea crops head in two samples. Need fixture-correct review before model winner.

entries.name: cozy gouache storybook
entries.reason: Krea transfers figure and background gouache while preserving equipment; Base blank faces and Turbo medium shifts/duplicate figure.

entries.name: watercolor storybook
entries.reason: Krea has the strongest complete watercolor transfer and equipment preservation; Anima stays largely cel/flat with wrong-side compass and Turbo extra body.

entries.name: folk fairytale gouache
entries.reason: Krea consistently restores the forest/gouache/magical-light features absent from both Anima rows and holds equipment side.

entries.name: vintage engraving
entries.reason: More complete fixture and readable engraving than Base blank faces/book-like equipment and Turbo duplicate figure.

entries.name: impasto painterly
entries.reason: Strong impasto plus fixture adherence; Anima color/side drift and Turbo missing compass remain.

entries.name: duotone risograph
entries.reason: Krea has stronger print texture, but middle compass construction is unresolved; no qualified winner.

entries.name: punk photocopy zine
entries.reason: Krea readable and correct side, but extra person; Base blank faces/wrong side and Turbo duplication prevent winner.

entries.name: flat vector editorial
entries.reason: Krea best palette/side but blank faces; Turbo readable vector faces but compass on wrong side. Requires game usability decision.

entries.name: mixed-media collage
entries.reason: Krea strongest layered cut-paper effect but face/offset-body ambiguity; Anima alternative defects persist.

entries.name: graphic neon cyberpunk
entries.reason: Krea correct fixture but softer graphic linework; Base has stronger graphic neon art and wrong side. Style-versus-fixture tradeoff unresolved.

entries.name: inked dark fantasy
entries.reason: Krea fantasy background stronger but face/hair integrity fails; Turbo necklace compass and Base unreadable faces/wrong side remain.

entries.name: clean dreamcore surreal
entries.reason: Most consistent completed fixture; Base duplicate compass and Turbo necklace equipment fail. Surreal specificity still needs review.

entries.name: retro airbrush future
entries.reason: Airbrush medium clearer in Krea but middle unreadable face; Anima rear/extra-figure defects leave no qualified winner.

entries.name: clay toy character
entries.reason: Only consistent clear clay toy medium with complete equipment; Anima Base generic flat forms and Turbo photo-like humans/duplicates fail.

entries.name: voxel diorama
entries.reason: Krea strongest voxel medium, but FRONT lock not maintained; Anima low-poly/cel/photo variation and equipment failures prevent winner.
